title: Lesson 3: Scaling Out & Load Balancing — js-tools
desc: Scaling up vs scaling out and the stateless requirement; L4 vs L7; four distribution algorithms — real measurements show round robin gives 340x worse p95 than least_conn when one replica degrades, even though the requests-per-node chart still looks balanced 11/10/9; active vs passive health checks; and a counter-intuitive finding: graceful shutdown makes no measurable difference for short requests but cuts tail latency 2.9x for long ones.
